title: Light the Lights
venue: The Muse Theatre, Lipson Co-operative Academy, Bernice Terrace, Plymouth, PL4 7PG
description: Top Hat and Tails presents Light the Lights, a musical revue bringing together numbers from Heathers, 42nd Street, Moulin Rouge!, Little Shop of Horrors, Sweet Charity, The Rocky Horror Show, Oklahoma! and more. Join us at The Muse Theatre for a celebration of musical theatre.
